item.title: USDA Cuts 2025 Farm Income as Weakness Persists Into 2026
item.description: Key Takeaways… USDA projects net farm income will slip lower in 2026 and remain roughly $48 billion (24 percent) below the record highs reached in 2022, underscoring a generational downturn in the farm economy. Strength in the beef market masks broader financial weakness across most commodity sectors. item.title: The “Urgent Need” to Fix Our Forests
item.description: January marked the one-year anniversary of the destructive Southern California wildfires, which claimed 31 lives and have been classified as the costliest wildfires in world history.
